claim_text: Rights to trial and privacy under overreach from the New York mayor, with false gods on the sides of buildings and great blasphemous events about to take place that will be in the news with hardly any outcry.
quote: Great blasphemous events are about to take place
falsify_match: A publicly staged blasphemous display in New York passing without significant protest.
falsify_miss: No such display. Blasphemous is undefined here, which lets a wide range of events count.

claim_text: The Supreme Court dropping something against Trump, with Ginsburg dropping the amendment tablets and Epstein standing there and the rest of the court behind her as if finished, and he asks again why she is present.
quote: They're dropping these amendments
falsify_match: A Supreme Court decision abandoning a case against the president alongside a rights ruling.
falsify_miss: No such pairing. He asks twice on air why a dead justice is in the scene, which he leaves unresolved.

claim_text: Interceding over the decisions the president makes about Iran in the next forty eight hours, across Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, tied to what he was shown about the 18th.
quote: the decisions he's making concerning Iran in the next 48 hours
falsify_match: A major American decision on Iran between 20 and 22 April 2026.
falsify_miss: No decision in that window. The days are named, which makes this scoreable.

claim_text: The 18th given as a very significant day concerning Iran with a major storm coming, which he ties to a report of a general walking out of a meeting after an argument with the president.
quote: It's the 18th. The Lord said this is a very significant day
falsify_match: A significant Iran decision or event on 18 April 2026.
falsify_miss: The day passes ordinarily. He supplies the significance afterwards from a report about a cabinet argument, which is the pattern to watch.

claim_text: Broadcast strings he says are codes to nuclear submarines and aircraft, recalled alongside sniffer aircraft he saw flying out of Miami over Cuba and over American landmarks looking for backpacks and briefcases.
quote: I saw by the spirit of the Lord uh sniffers
falsify_match: Radiological detection flights confirmed over Cuba and American cities.
falsify_miss: None confirmed. Such flights exist as a standing capability, which makes the sighting hard to distinguish from routine.

claim_text: A Trojan horse rather than a decoy, a boat with red, black and white carrying something radioactive into a harbour and setting it off, which he says was among the first visions he ever published.
quote: Radioactive inside a harbor
falsify_match: A radiological device delivered by ship into an American port.
falsify_miss: No such attack. He points to his own earliest videos as the record, which can be checked against the corpus.

claim_text: He points to a report that Iran has enough uranium for eleven nuclear devices held underground, as confirmation of the mountain he was shown with the material deep beneath it, which he had called plutonium.
quote: Iran has enough uranium for 11 nuclear devices
falsify_match: The earlier vision naming a number or a location that matches the reporting.
falsify_miss: The earlier telling names a mountain and a road, not a quantity; the eleven devices figure comes from the news report he is reading.

claim_text: One black missile perfected and saved for Israel with the payload of a Hiroshima device, with scientists heard arguing in English that they have never tested it but believe it will work and debating whether it is time.
quote: We have one missile. One to take out Israel
falsify_match: An Iranian nuclear device of that description used or discovered.
falsify_miss: None found. Hearing the scientists in English is a detail he offers without explanation.

claim_text: Antisemitism and gas lines worse than the 1970s with cars queuing a mile in some American places unable to get fuel, pointed at a thirty ton oil explosion at a Romanian heating plant that day.
quote: gas lines that were worse than the 1970s
falsify_match: Mile-long fuel queues in American states.
falsify_miss: No queues. He treats a Romanian plant fire as evidence for an American shortage, which does not follow.

claim_text: A massive refinery fire in India alongside the Romanian explosion, and the word to pray over American refineries because they are about to be targeted, naming Tuttle, Houston, Louisiana, the ports, drone attacks and sabotage.
quote: Pray over Tuttle. Pray over Houston
falsify_match: An attack or sabotage at an American refinery in one of the named places.
falsify_miss: No such attack. Tuttle is a small Oklahoma town near where he lives, which makes it the specific and unusual name on the list.

claim_text: Kim and China devising a plan to take the chips from Taiwan, with underground deals and planes flying aid in the middle of the night in secret before the strikes, and certain capabilities China is trying to give them.
quote: devising a plan of of how to take the chips
falsify_match: A Chinese move against Taiwanese semiconductor capacity.
falsify_miss: No such move. The night flights are attributed to Iran rather than Taiwan in the same passage, which makes the target ambiguous.

claim_text: He compares the Japanese earthquake that had just happened, a 7.4 or 7.5 toward the tip, with the one he was shown toward the middle and inland where the buildings rocked so badly they looked about to fall, and says he does not think this is the one.
quote: So, is this the one that the Lord showed me? I don't think so
falsify_match: A larger inland Japanese earthquake still to come.
falsify_miss: None comes. He is explicit that the event that occurred does not match what he saw, which is a rare declining of a fulfilment.

claim_text: Mount Fuji completely losing its top in a major eruption that kills hundreds of thousands if not millions, happening suddenly, which he says is just the beginning of the ring of fire.
quote: killed literally hundreds of thousands if not millions
falsify_match: A Fuji eruption with a casualty toll in the hundreds of thousands.
falsify_miss: Fuji stays quiet. This is the first time a death toll is attached to the Fuji claim, which makes it sharper than the earlier tellings.

claim_text: The earthquake he saw for Japan was more like a 9.0 in the middle rather than the 7.5 that happened, and he asks whether he missed it; and an 8.2 in Rome that shakes and splits the walls of the Vatican with houses shaken to the ground and rubble on people, with an underwater volcano about to go off just outside Italy.
quote: it will shake as an 8.2 two in Rome, Italy
falsify_match: A magnitude 8.2 earthquake at Rome damaging the Vatican.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake. Italy's largest recorded events are around 7.1; an 8.2 exceeds what the Apennine faults can produce, which makes the number wrong for the place.

claim_text: The five major shakings recalled with the shaking of the earth said to be happening now, and a third major leak from the Supreme Court in four years noted as unheard of.
quote: Five major shakings, a shaking in the earth, and they're happening
falsify_match: All five shakings arriving together.
falsify_miss: Only ordinary seismicity. A magnitude 7.5 is a normal year for Japan, which is the base rate problem.

claim_text: Prayer for clarity in the president's inner circle amid bickering, and a run of questions about whether Iran will be taken back to the stone age, its power grid or oil facilities destroyed, and whether America becomes the oil capital of the world with everyone buying from it.
quote: Will America become the oil capital of the world?
falsify_match: American energy exports displacing Gulf supply after strikes on Iran.
falsify_miss: No such shift. He puts this as a series of questions rather than a statement, which is worth recording.

claim_text: The same questions repeated about taking out the grid and the oil facilities, eliminating the island, and a train of oil coming out of America under drill baby drill.
quote: It'll be like a big train of oil coming out of America
falsify_match: American crude exports rising to global dominance.
falsify_miss: America is already the largest crude producer, so the shift would have to be in exports and pricing power rather than output.

claim_text: The Strait of Hormuz becoming obsolete because Iranian oil facilities are annihilated, Venezuelan oil used by America and Cuba next, with Greenland mineral deals following, and Cuba about to be freed and commercialised while Brazil and Germany object to the blockade.
quote: the straight of Hermoose becoming obsolete
falsify_match: Hormuz losing its strategic weight with Venezuelan and Cuban supply replacing it.
falsify_miss: Hormuz still carries about a fifth of world oil. Cuba has negligible reserves, which makes it the weakest link in the sequence.

claim_text: Thanks that the Boston Marathon runners were protected with no explosions or shootings, and prayer over the president's decision on Iran that night and Wednesday, said to turn on which oil facilities they think they can take.
quote: there was no explosions, no shootings, no nothing
falsify_match: Not applicable; thanks for a non-event.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though crediting an uneventful marathon to prayer is the pattern that makes absences into confirmations.

claim_text: An oil rig burning in Russia and natural gas facilities burning there, specifically the ones supplying Europe, with a major disruption in the lines.
quote: I see natural gas facilities burning in Russia
falsify_match: Strikes on Russian gas infrastructure serving Europe.
falsify_miss: No such strikes. Russian pipeline gas to Europe had already collapsed to a fraction of its former volume, which limits what disruption would mean.

claim_text: Carney and Canada coming alongside as America tries to be a spark there, with China named in the same breath.
quote: I see Carney coming alongside
falsify_match: A Canadian energy arrangement with China.
falsify_miss: None. The passage is fragmentary and he repeats it twice.

claim_text: The same fragment repeated with China and Canada named together.
quote: China and Canada. China. Canada
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; repetition without added content.

claim_text: He describes his method of going nation by nation to find which is hot, and sees Canada and China making major deals for gas and oil because of what is happening with Iran, with major fires still across Iran.
quote: I'm bouncing from area to area looking for the hot spot
falsify_match: Canada and China signing energy deals during an Iran crisis.
falsify_miss: No such deals. The method description is the useful part: he sweeps for a hot spot rather than being given one.

claim_text: A series in the spirit of hearts being hardened like Pharaoh's as Iran comes to the table and then refuses, which he says explains why the leaders act as they do, and which is about liberating the people and a revival about to break out in Iran.
quote: And then he hardened Pharaoh's heart
falsify_match: Negotiations repeatedly collapsing at the point of agreement, followed by an Iranian opening to Christianity.
falsify_miss: Talks succeed, or fail without any religious opening. The Pharaoh framing means refusal is expected, so a breakdown confirms it.

claim_text: Russia and China telling Iran to take the deal while the heart is hardened, compared to a game show contestant refusing the banker's offer.
quote: I see Russia trying to say take the deal
falsify_match: Russia and China publicly pressing Iran to accept terms.
falsify_miss: They do not, or Iran accepts. Both had already urged de-escalation publicly, which is the baseline.

claim_text: Technology that has never been used before heard about in the meeting, with Israel having something too, and prayer for an impenetrable firewall over American nuclear, water and electrical facilities and against Edward Snowden moments.
quote: It's using technology that has never been used before
falsify_match: A novel weapon or capability disclosed after use.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. Never used before is unfalsifiable until something is used and identified as new.

claim_text: Hidden back doors in computers logging information, political theatre, and a reading that the Iranian leader's treatment turns on his being Muslim and on a brotherhood with the New York mayor, one having bowed to the other.
quote: I see hidden back doors and computers
falsify_match: Disclosure of back doors in American systems.
falsify_miss: No disclosure. The brotherhood reading connects two figures on religion alone.

claim_text: Prayer to shake the land once more with Pharaoh's heart hardened across Iran, to shake North Korea and Kim, and to bring revival across North Korea, Cuba, Argentina, Brazil and Africa amid great persecution.
quote: Shake Iran. Shake North Korea, Lord
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Iran about to be shaken at a level nothing has been shaken in this generation, with God delivering the people from a leadership bent on killing with nuclear weapons, and Pakistan named as beating its war drums with nuclear capability like Turkey.
quote: Iran is about to be shaken in a level that you've never seen
falsify_match: Regime collapse in Iran with Pakistani involvement.
falsify_miss: The regime holds and Pakistan stays out. Pakistan is the nuclear-armed name here, which is the specific part.

claim_text: Pakistan trying to get involved and beating war drums as he says he saw, with prayer over the president's decisions, his wife, his children and his health.
quote: they'll start to beat their war drums in the days ahead
falsify_match: Pakistani mobilisation over Iran.
falsify_miss: Pakistan stays out. It has its own confrontation with India, which is where its mobilisations have actually occurred.

claim_text: Flowers budding as a new industrial revolution: lavender coming up all over Russia, a red lotus out of China with black mould growing on it, and beautiful vibrant flowers elsewhere.
quote: I could see lavender popping up all over Russia
falsify_match: Russian and Chinese economic revival with a flaw in the Chinese one.
falsify_miss: Not checkable as stated. The black mould on the Chinese flower is the interpretable detail.

claim_text: A beautiful yellow flower out of South Korea and flowers throughout the world representing new growth and a new plumb line, with a massive boulder moved out of a blocked river in the spirit which he connects to bankers and to the wealth of the sinner.
quote: it represented a new growth
falsify_match: A banking blockage clearing and funds flowing to the church.
falsify_miss: No such flow. He corrects himself mid-passage about which flower belonged to which country.

claim_text: He reads a Jerusalem Post report about talks the president says are set for Tuesday, with a caveat about how much fake news is around.
quote: there is a This is the Jerusalem Post
falsify_match: Not applicable; a news item read out.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: The grey-headed bald man identified by name as Reza, the prince, to be prayed for and protected, with Iran expected within forty eight hours, and a defence of the Coachella word: he says he never predicted a shooting there but sex trafficking of teenage girls.
quote: He's the prince, right? Reza
falsify_match: Reza Pahlavi taking a leadership role in Iran.
falsify_miss: He does not. Naming the exiled crown prince is the most specific identification of an Iranian successor in the corpus.

claim_text: He restates that he warned about sex trafficking of nineteen and twenty year old women at Coachella rather than a shooting, and that he told young women to take a brother with them, then recalls seeing mass shootings across the land.
quote: I didn't say there would be a shooting at Coachella
falsify_match: The earlier recording matching what he says he said.
falsify_miss: The earlier recording says something broader. This is checkable directly against the corpus, which is why it is worth keeping.

claim_text: A black bull with horns and a nose ring fed human sacrifice through abortion, with a more developed foetus counting as a better sacrifice, tied to mass shootings, a Hitler spirit around this time of year and Columbine, and to eight children in Louisiana the previous night.
quote: the more developed the child, the more bigger was
falsify_match: A cluster of attacks on children around the Columbine anniversary.
falsify_miss: No cluster. The 20 April window has a documented history of copycat incidents, which is the base rate here.

claim_text: He acknowledges something happened that was not prevented, says we live in a fallen world and he does not know, and asks what else might have been prevented that nobody saw, then notes the president held a major cabinet meeting on the 18th about Iran.
quote: What did we prevent that we didn't see?
falsify_match: Not applicable; a response to a warning that did not hold.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. What was prevented that nobody saw is the argument that makes any failure unfalsifiable, and it is stated plainly here.

claim_text: One more round coming in Iran in which major leaders are eliminated again and which will be the end of it, with a season and window of revival following and troops on the ground in certain places that did not look healthy, and prayer to find the weapons of mass destruction under the mountain.
quote: There'll be one more round
falsify_match: A second round of strikes killing Iranian leaders, followed by ground troops.
falsify_miss: No second round. One more round and then the end is a bounded claim, which makes it scoreable once the campaign ends.

claim_text: The strait opening and closing repeatedly, oil trying to go over two hundred dollars a barrel with viewers reporting it already selling above that elsewhere, and great antisemitism rising worldwide which he says is happening now, naming Tucker Carlson and alternative media.
quote: the straits open, the straits close
falsify_match: Brent or WTI closing above two hundred dollars.
falsify_miss: Neither benchmark reaches it. He allows that viewers say it has hit in other nations, which loosens the benchmark.

claim_text: A man arrested in the United Kingdom for praying because his prayers caused anxiety while street prayers block whole roads, given as the great persecution he said would come to the church in the UK and Canada, out of which revival breaks like an olive press, with tax exemption also named.
quote: another Christian for praying. His prayers were causing anxiety
falsify_match: A pattern of arrests for silent prayer in Britain and Canada with church growth following.
falsify_miss: Arrests stay isolated and no growth follows. British buffer zone arrests were already a running news story before this.

claim_text: A general in the cartel taken out with turf wars following, drug lords from Venezuela and Colombia fighting over who is in charge, and Delta Force and mercenaries taking these men out, which he calls a cleansing of the land.
quote: there's going to be turf wars
falsify_match: American special forces killing cartel leaders and a succession war following.
falsify_miss: No such operations. Turf wars follow every cartel decapitation, which is the base rate.

claim_text: Three major cartel leaders taken out in the days ahead causing a turf war across Mexico, Venezuela and Cuba, recalled alongside the stucco house in Miami and the Hispanic girl he was told to pray for who was going to inform.
quote: I saw three major leaders being taken out
falsify_match: Three named cartel figures killed in a short window.
falsify_miss: Fewer or more. The number three is the checkable part, since he names nobody.

claim_text: American streets seen on fire in New York City with the mayor present in the footage he is showing.
quote: They're lighting our streets on fire
falsify_match: Sustained street disorder in New York.
falsify_miss: Isolated incidents only. He is describing footage on screen rather than a vision.

claim_text: A drought coming across America with the farmers in trouble, the words there is no water repeated three times, tractors at a standstill across the country and another dust bowl, which he says a broadcaster he watched has now said independently with inside sources.
quote: There is no water. And it was said three times
falsify_match: A dust bowl scale drought halting American planting.
falsify_miss: Ordinary drought cycles. Independent agreement from a broadcaster is being treated as corroboration of the vision.

claim_text: He repeats the dust bowl and drought material and says the broadcaster spoke about farmers, crops and the drought and has more coming, and that most people have no idea where things truly are, which is why he has talked about tower gardens and growing your own food.
quote: I saw another dust bowl coming
falsify_match: A multi-year agricultural failure across the plains.
falsify_miss: Yields stay within range. The tower garden advice is the practical instruction attached to it.
